div.h1:
Showroom Orders
Without the Measurement Chaos
div.p: StitchLab gives tailoring showrooms one powerful tablet workflow to capture orders, precise measurements, detailed instructions, dynamic pricing, and real-time cloth tracking from a single screen.
Walk into the showroom and explore a world of possibilities. From chic contemporary tops to graceful Panjabi-style kurtis and flowing salwar suits, your dream design starts with a single tap.

img.alt: Ladies Kurtis and Tops Boutique Display

div.p: Handpick from luxurious linens, soft cottons, and rich blends. Then shape every detail, from necklines and sleeves to buttons and trims that reflect your personality.

img.alt: Traditional South Asian Block Print Cotton Fabrics

div.p: Your exact fit lives with us forever. Shoulders, sleeves, chest, and length are digitally stored so every future order drapes flawlessly.
Review your complete design on screen before a single stitch is made. Approve lace borders, pairings, pocket styles, and every important detail with confidence.
Your outfit gets a smart tracking tag. Follow its journey from cutting table to stitching line to final dispatch, and know exactly when it is ready.
Every fit starts with precision. We take and record each body measurement with care — shoulder, chest, waist, length, and more — so nothing is guessed and nothing is missed.
Measurements alone are not enough. Our tailors process every cloth according to its unique weight and weave, ensuring the cut and stitch always match your exact body proportions.
Say goodbye to paper slips. Every measurement is captured digitally on a tablet, stored in your profile, and instantly ready for any future order — no re-measuring needed.
A perfectly stitched garment deserves a flawless finish. Every piece is carefully pressed and finished before delivery, so it arrives crisp, shaped, and ready to wear.
Your time matters. We track every order against its promised delivery date and manage our production schedule to ensure your outfit arrives exactly when expected — every time.
Every decision we make starts with you. Your preferences, your timeline, and your satisfaction are the top priority at every stage — from measurement to delivery.
We are always here. Get real-time updates on your order, ask questions, request changes, and receive guidance at every step — without ever needing to visit the showroom.
Log accurate body dimensions, structural configurations, and customized sizing rules instantly.
Dictate custom specifications, edge trimmings, or dynamic modification logs hands-free.
Inject premium configurations like custom lace variants, layout modules, and button sets.
Provide exact construction blueprints via production video snippets, voice markers, or fabric layout imagery.
Scan assigned labels to verify physical location status on machine lines or cutting boards.
Replicate exact cuts and styling details using physical sample clothes provided by customers.
StitchLab made ordering my wedding outfit completely stress-free. I chose my fabric, customized the neck design, and they got my measurements right the first time.
StitchLab remembered my measurements from my first visit. Now I just walk in, pick a style, and it is stitched perfectly.
The tablet interface at the showroom was so easy. I showed them a sample picture, and they replicated the exact embroidery pattern.

article.p: Need it sooner? Your order is fast-tracked for special occasions without compromising quality.
We plan every order around your promised delivery date, so your outfit arrives when expected.
Your garment is entrusted to skilled cutting masters for precision on every stitch.
Chat anytime about your order and get progress updates without leaving home.
Add another kurti or split a set while keeping the order flow hassle-free.
Your design flows from tablet to workshop floor with fewer manual mix-ups.
